data.name: Acid Blood Gift
data.description: If a creature damages you with a slashing or piercing manufactured weapon, it must succeed at a Reflex saving throw (DC %1) or its weapon takes %2 points of acid damage; this damage is not halved before it is applied to the weapon's hardness. If a creature damages you with a slashing or piercing natural weapon, it must succeed at the save or take that amount of acid damage itself.|10+TL/2+HiveManifestationLevel|2*HiveManifestationLevel
